Privacy Policy

Last Updated: November 11, 2026

At RealSalePro ("we," "our," or "us"), operated by Synergy Brand Architect, we respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, process, store, and protect digital personal data when you use our real estate CRM software platform, website (realsalepro.com), and associated integrations.

1. Legal and Regulatory Framework

This Privacy Policy is framed in accordance with applicable data protection laws of the Republic of India, specifically:

  • The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act") (Act No. 22 of 2023);
  • The Information Technology Act, 2000 and rules framed thereunder;
  • The Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011; and
  • Applicable project disclosure guidelines under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 ("RERA").

2. Data Fiduciary and Data Processor Capacities

  • RealSalePro as Data Fiduciary: With respect to direct account holders, subscribers, billing information, and registered administrators, RealSalePro determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.
  • RealSalePro as Data Processor: When subscribers (real estate developers, builders, channel partners, and brokers) import, capture, or manage prospective buyer leads via CRM campaigns, Meta Lead Ads, or third-party webhooks, the subscriber acts as the Data Fiduciary, and RealSalePro processes such data strictly on their behalf as a Data Processor pursuant to Section 8(2) of the DPDP Act.

3. Categories of Information We Collect

We collect and process only data strictly necessary to deliver our CRM software services:

  • Account & Profile Data: Full Name, Business Email Address, Mobile Number, Company / Firm Name, RERA Registration Number (where applicable), and Billing Address.
  • Prospective Buyer Lead Data: Customer Contact Numbers (protected by role-based phone masking), Names, Preferred Property Locations, Budgets, and Site Visit Logs uploaded by subscribers.
  • System & Usage Logs: IP addresses, browser types, device fingerprints, and authentication access timestamps for fraud prevention.

4. Security Standards & Encryption

We deploy bank-grade technical and organizational safeguards:

  • Encryption: AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.3 transport security for all data in transit.
  • Access Controls: Role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication, and proprietary telecaller phone number masking to prevent lead theft.
  • Multi-Tenant Isolation: Logical isolation across tenant workspaces with optional private PostgreSQL database hosting (BYOD).

5. Grievance Officer & Inquiries

In accordance with Section 12 of the DPDP Act, 2023, for any privacy concerns, data subject requests, or grievance redressal, please contact our Grievance Officer:
